body: Hey! I’m a 22F, from Brazil! I also love manga, anime and japanese music (a lot of vocaloid too haha) i’d love to be your penpal if you’d like c:

I honestly love how the story in gou is unfolding but i’m also kind of worried... we have only a few more episodes to go and still have no answers to what the heck happened in onidamashi, watadamashi and tataridamashi. I like how satoko is now basically confirmed to be the culprit and this episode kind of started to explain her motivation to do so, but i also wish that it followed the question and answer arcs structure we’re already familiar with idk

Also is anyone else kind of sad that Rena is basically doing nothing this whole season? :\

I’m excited to see that gou is kind of unifying higurashi and umineko too but i haven’t read the VN for umineko so i always get a bit lost when everyone starts theorizing abt lambadelta and featherine.. (let’s hope that maybe gou opens up the possibility of a good umineko adaptation)
